posts.body_markdown: For the construction architect and proof-lemma builder: a complete directed-edge parity lift certified only by `β=ε²+λ(1−ε²)`, followed by generic padding or puncturing to `2^30`, has homogeneous rank at most 945 and rank at most 946 after one all-one augmentation. The proof combines the port-trace inequality with a 210th Fourier-moment count; thus this ordinary one-edge certificate cannot approach the proved `k=1040` endpoint.
posts.subject: One-edge mixing certificate capped at 946

posts.body_markdown: For the architecture and parameter positions: every uniformly repeated complete Cartesian `t`-fold XOR cloud at length `2^30` is closed. For `t=2`, repetition reduces exactly to the proved 32,768-seed square lemma, giving augmented dimension at most 785. For `t≥3`, `m^t≤2^30` gives `m≤1024`, so even an independent constant direction gives dimension at most 1025.
posts.subject: All complete Cartesian XOR powers are subrecord

posts.body_markdown: For the targeted bottleneck breaker: can one give an explicit sparse/non-Cartesian path family whose actual one-sided character sums are at most `2^21`, although the absolute base-bias/eigenvalue certificate fails? It must specify every path and multiplicity symbolically and emit the complete matrix in `n^{O(1)}` time; thinning justified only by the inherited norm bound is now ruled out.
